decisions.reason: The 15-day express option still overlaps with the broader express line and lacks distinct option value, so the firm abandons it.
The fire-resistant exterior door has European approval and home-page presence, indicating realized value, so the firm keeps it.
The multi-model express delivery line retains option value across segments and has its own page, so the firm keeps it.
The online ordering and digital services platform remains a strategic option with high unresolved uncertainty, so the firm keeps it.
